verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 SXM is physical GPU hardware. Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a category error for a data-center accelerator, and no buyer comparing GPUs would reasonably ask it. Nothing in the evidence shows the H200 itself ships any credential or API-key scoping capability. The build.nvidia.com inference endpoints are a separate NVIDIA service, and no credential-scoping evidence is given for them either, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
